tooling.message:
fix(publish): write .nojekyll into the bundle so Pages serves files starting with _

## Intent

Pages ran published apps through Jekyll, which drops files whose names start with an underscore, so components did not start (#107).

## Key changes

- The publish step writes an empty .nojekyll into the bundle, next to the marker file.

## Dependencies and side effects

- Closes #107.

tooling.message:
fix(skills): mark rules-review as internal so npx skills add skips it

## Intent

`npx skills add lernapps/tooling` installed the maintainers' skill rules-review into apps (#85).

## Key changes

- rules-review is marked `metadata.internal`; the skills CLI lists such skills only when INSTALL_INTERNAL_SKILLS is set.

## Dependencies and side effects

- Closes #85.
